verdict.rationale: CrewAI has no native natural-language command interface. Its authoring surfaces are Python code, the CLI, and a drag-and-drop, form-based Visual Builder. It does officially support operating the framework through external coding agents: a ready-to-paste setup prompt for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor installs official CrewAI skills, checks the CLI and points the agent at docs, backed by an llms.txt index. Agent roles and task descriptions are also written in plain language, but they are configured in code or forms rather than issued as commands. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language or chat interface to create, run and manage crews; evidence that Crew Studio accepts prompt-based commands; independent hands-on corroboration of the coding-agent workflow.
